top: Every thing that may abide the fire,
bottom: ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean...

top: Save Caleb... and Joshua the son of Nun:
bottom: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

top: And Moses wrote their goings out
bottom: according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD...

top: these forty years the LORD thy God
bottom: hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

top: But charge Joshua, and encourage him,
bottom: and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people...

top: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God,
bottom: thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart...

top: the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you.
bottom: But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

top: And ye shall teach them your children,
bottom: speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house...

top: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God,
bottom: ...and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

top: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast
bottom: ...therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

top: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you,
bottom: to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

top: ...it shall be for the stranger,
bottom: for the fatherless, and for the widow...

top: And all these blessings shall come on thee,
bottom: and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice...

top: he will be with thee, he will not fail thee,
bottom: neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

top: As an eagle stirreth up her nest,
bottom: ...spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them...

top: Sanctify yourselves:
bottom: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

top: My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD...
bottom: and make confession unto him... hide it not from me.

top: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded,
bottom: which Joshua read not before all the congregation...

top: And now, behold, we are in thine hand:
bottom: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

top: ...so did Joshua; he left nothing undone
bottom: of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

top: Give me a blessing... give me also springs of water.
bottom: And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

top: There failed not ought of any good thing
bottom: which the LORD had spoken... all came to pass.

top: ...called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness
bottom: between us that the LORD is God.

top: ...the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying,
bottom: Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first...

top: ...then the LORD was with the judge,
bottom: ...for it repented the LORD because of their groanings...

top: But let them that love him be as the sun
bottom: when he goeth forth in his might.

top: ...and they cried,
bottom: The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

top: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave
bottom: my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man...

top: And they put away the strange gods from among them,
bottom: and served the LORD...

top: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace:
bottom: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

top: And the old man said, Peace be with thee;
bottom: howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me...

top: ...and came unto the house of God, and wept,
bottom: and sat there before the LORD...

top: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid;
bottom: for thou art a near kinsman.

top: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
bottom: and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill...

top: ...behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face
bottom: to the earth before the ark of the LORD.

top: but stand thou still a while,
bottom: that I may shew thee the word of God.

top: ...when he had turned his back to go from Samuel,
bottom: God gave him another heart...

top: it may be that the LORD will work for us:
bottom: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save...

top: the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David
bottom: and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

top: ...The LORD be between me and thee,
bottom: and between my seed and thy seed for ever.

top: And every one that was in distress... gathered
bottom: themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them...

top: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou,
bottom: which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood...

top: The LORD render to every man his righteousness
bottom: and his faithfulness...

top: Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright,
bottom: and thy going out and thy coming in... is good in my sight...

top: ...but David waxed stronger and stronger,
bottom: and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

top: and the LORD said to thee,
bottom: Thou shalt feed my people Israel...

top: Be of good courage, and let us play the men
bottom: ...and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

top: And the soul of king David longed
bottom: to go forth unto Absalom...

top: yet doth he devise means,
bottom: that his banished be not expelled from him.

top: ...behold, here am I,
bottom: let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

top: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction
bottom: and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing...

top: Therefore the king said unto Shimei,
bottom: Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

top: And Rizpah... took sackcloth, and spread it
bottom: for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest...

top: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given
bottom: one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

top: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God,
bottom: to walk in his ways...
